user.title: Add Adaptive Room Manager
user.description: Choose whether to configure the home-wide schedule and defaults or add a room based on an existing Home Assistant area.

home.title: Home Settings
home.description: Configure the global schedule used by every room. The illuminance threshold and absence delay are copied only as starting values when a new room is created.

data_description.evening_start: Time at which every room changes from the day lighting profile to the evening lighting profile.
data_description.night_start: Time at which every room changes to the night lighting profile. The night profile continues across midnight until Morning start.
data_description.morning_start: Time at which every room leaves the night profile and returns to the day profile.
data_description.lux_threshold: Initial threshold offered when a new room is added. Existing rooms keep their own threshold when this value changes.
data_description.absence_delay: Initial delay offered when a new room is added. Existing rooms keep their own delay when this value changes.

room.title: Add an adaptive room
room.description: Select an existing Home Assistant area and configure its presence and lighting behavior. A dedicated device will be created and associated with the selected area.

data_description.area_id: The existing Home Assistant area represented by this room. Only one Adaptive Room Manager entry can be created for each area.
data_description.trigger_presence_sensors: Sensors allowed to trigger occupancy. A vacant room becomes occupied only when at least one trigger sensor and at least one persistent sensor are active. The same entity may be selected in both lists.
data_description.persistent_presence_sensors: Sensors that confirm and maintain occupancy. They are required together with a trigger sensor to activate a vacant room. After activation, either an active trigger or an active persistent sensor keeps the room occupied. The same entity may be selected in both lists.
data_description.lux_sensors: Sensors used to estimate natural room illuminance. Their average is stored only while all managed room lights are off. The integration never switches lights off temporarily to perform a lux test.
data_description.covers: Covers used as a natural-light fallback when no stored illuminance value is available. Unavailable or unknown covers are ignored; any other state except closed is treated as open.
data_description.day_lights: Lights controlled while the global period is Day. They turn on only when the room is occupied and the integration determines that light is needed.
data_description.evening_lights: Lights controlled while the global period is Evening. The Evening start time is configured only in Home Settings.
data_description.night_lights: Lights controlled while the global period is Night. The Night and Morning start times are configured only in Home Settings.
data_description.lux_threshold: The room needs artificial light when the stored natural illuminance is below this value. This setting is specific to this room.
data_description.absence_delay: How long all trigger and persistent sensors must remain inactive before an occupied room becomes vacant. If any configured presence sensor becomes active during the delay, the timer is cancelled.

abort.already_configured: This Home Settings entry or Home Assistant area is already managed.

home.title: Home Settings
home.description: Change the global schedule used by every configured room. Default threshold and delay values affect only rooms created afterwards.

data_description.evening_start: Time at which every room changes from the day lighting profile to the evening lighting profile.
data_description.night_start: Time at which every room changes to the night lighting profile. The night profile continues across midnight until Morning start.
data_description.morning_start: Time at which every room leaves the night profile and returns to the day profile.
data_description.lux_threshold: Initial threshold offered when a new room is added. Changing it does not overwrite existing room settings.
data_description.absence_delay: Initial delay offered when a new room is added. Changing it does not overwrite existing room settings.

room.title: Room settings
room.description: Configure the sensors and lights for this room. Morning, evening, and night times are inherited from Home Settings and are not duplicated here.

data_description.trigger_presence_sensors: Sensors allowed to trigger occupancy. A vacant room becomes occupied only when at least one trigger sensor and at least one persistent sensor are active. The same entity may be selected in both lists.
data_description.persistent_presence_sensors: Sensors that confirm and maintain occupancy. After the room becomes occupied, an active sensor from either list keeps it occupied. The same entity may be selected in both lists.
data_description.lux_sensors: Their average is stored while all managed lights are off. Managed lights are never switched off and back on to measure natural illuminance.
data_description.covers: Used only as a fallback when no stored lux value exists. Unavailable and unknown covers are ignored; any other state except closed is considered open.
data_description.day_lights: Lights controlled during the global Day period.
data_description.evening_lights: Lights controlled during the global Evening period.
data_description.night_lights: Lights controlled during the global Night period.
data_description.lux_threshold: Artificial light is needed below this stored natural-illuminance value.
data_description.absence_delay: After occupancy has started, all sensors in both presence lists must remain inactive for this duration before the room becomes vacant.
